plan.title: Reverse Dutch rejects start price below end price

steps.note: Use the single-stage flow required for Dutch conversion.
Allow vendors to be added during creation.
Create the RFQ prerequisite for a Dutch auction.
Give the prerequisite event a unique title.
Add the specified product and quantity.
Confirm the location selection was retained.
Invite two QA vendors without treating Vendor A and Vendor B as literal company names.
Commit the prerequisite RFQ's bidding schedule.
Open the converted auction create screen where Dutch strategy is available.
Set the exact reverse Dutch price relationship under test.
